brief: Review the open defect register for Ivybridge Green (SUB-SGW-340) before the heat event, as governed by SOP-016. If a vegetation or obstruction defect is outstanding, clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity as directed by SOP-011. Since the unit is 43 years old, note that age in service serves as a proxy indicator for insulation condition under MG-023 when no historical data exists.
